purpose: Concrete development history mapped to AI Enablement Manager responsibilities, not an employer motivation statement.
attribution: Haris specifies needs, supplies context, directs coding agents, challenges outputs and reviews work. Agent-produced code and assistant-maintained histories are not unaided human authorship.

episodes.title: Two coding assistants, one durable working record
episodes.problem: Continuity between development tools rather than repeatedly restating the same project.
episodes.owner_action: Requested Codex to assess the repository, assign work to Claude and use shared Markdown to record task progress and completion.
episodes.agent_action: The surviving professional session records agent implementation and project-file activity around that direction.
episodes.input: Repository and design material; current task and handoff state.
episodes.output: A files-first coordination method: task, changes, verification and next work live with the project.
limits: Does not prove models share weights or learn from one another
No quantified time saving

episodes.title: Bidding relevance before more source volume
episodes.problem: Unclear buyers, weak opportunity relevance, incomplete expert records and workflow relationships that did not connect.
episodes.owner_action: Challenged whether the findings came from real records or assumptions; required module blueprints to reflect the implemented code and a coherent radar-to-analysis-to-workshop flow.
episodes.agent_action: Implemented shared-context specialist analysis; three branches cover business fit, staffing and compliance, then a dependent operations synthesis consumes available results.
episodes.input: Opportunity, extracted assignment requirements, organisational context and source-quality signals.
episodes.output: Structured analysis with complete, partial or failed state; unknowns remain visible.
limits: Implementation verified, not measured tender-win uplift or customer adoption
Private client source is not licensed for public redistribution

episodes.title: Separating model capability from the surrounding harness
episodes.problem: Understanding what depends on a model and what belongs to reusable context, tools and operating method.
episodes.owner_action: Asked whether the system was an LLM and how different models could attach to the same working method; requested inspection before architectural change.
episodes.output: A defensible distinction between pretrained model, role/context contracts, memory records, provider interfaces and checks.
limits: Not a claim to have created a foundation model
Provider equivalence not established

episodes.title: A Slack-agent incident became a maintenance rule
episodes.problem: A historical Slack responder fleet refused to answer because an ancestor directory contained a context marker forbidden by its sealed-working-directory check.
episodes.owner_or_task_direction: The supplied task identified the failure mode and requested verification, recovery and runbook hardening.
episodes.agent_action: At inspection the marker had already disappeared. The recorded check returned true; the per-call check allowed recovery without restarting the supervisor. The runbook was updated to explain the intermittent failure and prevention rule.
episodes.output: A documented symptom/cause/diagnose/prevent sequence, with no unnecessary source-code edit or deletion claimed.
limits: Historical task and agent-maintained incident report, not unaided owner diagnosis
Current source corroborates per-call seal; historical live recovery not freshly rerun
No uptime percentage or nine independently deployed products

episodes.title: A future-proof fix must preserve existing workflows
episodes.problem: A workflow needed a deeper fix without breaking already-developed behavior.
episodes.owner_action: Explicitly asked for multiple-agent investigation, a durable fix and precision about preserving working workflows.
episodes.owner_quote: the fix needs to be future proof not only now
episodes.output: A recorded acceptance constraint: improvement must not quietly regress the surrounding system.
limits: Quote proves the requirement, not successful repair or regression-free production

episodes.title: Slack-facing agents with controlled context and reversible engines
episodes.owner_action: The original professional history explicitly requires wiring the agents and available Slack connector before expanding the next product.
episodes.agent_implementation: The bridge implements Slack event handlers, thread delivery, role lookup and model response routing. Company-facing responses use bounded role briefs and a neutral working directory. Current code can select CLI, SDK, OpenAI-compatible or Gemini backends, including selected-agent canaries and explicit CLI rollback.
episodes.safety_detail: SDK options replace the system prompt, inherit no settings, expose an empty toolset and deny unapproved actions. The bridge includes a 40-reply/600-second rolling-window guard for its reply path.
episodes.output: A source-implemented communication surface and model-transition seam rather than only a diagram.
limits: Fresh source inspection, no network call or current-live Slack health test
Reply guard is not a universal billing cap
Private integration code remains private
No verified enterprise rollout or employer-controlled account handover

episodes.title: Audit paid dependencies before adding more infrastructure
episodes.owner_action: Requested a read-only inventory of billable services, their purpose and which dependencies were leftover or unused, explicitly excluding secret values.
episodes.output: A cost/dependency investigation requirement anchored in an actual professional session.
limits: Does not prove a dependency was retired or savings realised
Receipt payments separately documented; not inferred from this prompt

episodes.title: Local implementation and checks before deployment
episodes.owner_action: Directed agents to build locally, run tests, QA and end-to-end checks before uploading the result to hosted systems; requested separate builder and tester roles.
episodes.agent_action: Historical assessment contains recorded agent dispatches and bounded passing-test outputs; the source families include working prototypes.
episodes.output: Evidence of staged validation and role separation, not simply asking a chatbot for code.
limits: Testing requirement is not proof every requested suite passed
No current external adoption/deployment claim
Background stop notifications are not successful completion

episodes.title: CareerAgent: evidence survives drafting and browser work
episodes.problem: The owner reports repeated corrections, lost context and unsupported CV statements; these are reported problems, not a measured baseline.
episodes.input: Approved professional sources, source-index metadata, safe factual claims, role requirements and application package artifacts.
episodes.agent_implementation: Python lexical all-term retrieval uses bounded privacy-minimised excerpts; separate SQLite source and application schemas retain provenance and workflow state. Package hashes, claim usage and a staged begin/authorise/complete coordinator bind work to current reviewed artifacts.
episodes.failure_recovery: Unknown external outcomes stop retries for manual receipt reconciliation. Stale interrupted attempts recover only with receipt-backed status or become unknown.
episodes.output: Reviewable CV/technical-answer packages and receipt-controlled status; the Epoch role was found during AI-assisted career research and this package is being prepared through the same system.
limits: Epoch application not submitted
No measured hours saved
Lexical not vector retrieval
Separate database transactions are not distributed ACID
Controls do not prove security assurance or eliminate all browser failures

episodes.title: Teaching a context-first method that a participant can try alone
episodes.owner_action: Provided individual coaching and a framework distinguishing essential task inputs from useful background.
episodes.participant_action: A participant independently tested the framework on a hypothetical consulting assignment, reported practical value and asked how to move to a real assignment and review outputs.
episodes.output: A proposed next-stage working plan with role procedures, reporting, delivery artifacts and a supervised pilot.
limits: Prior provider-verified register, not email refetched in this pass
One individual hypothetical trial, not company-wide training
No measured learning or productivity uplift
Participant identity/employer/quotes private

episodes.title: Local-model adaptation with a clear evaluation boundary
episodes.agent_implementation: Saved Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct LoRA configuration and run summary record 2,721 pairs, two epochs, rank 16 and 8,257,536 trainable parameters.
episodes.output: A historical adapter artifact and recorded training run dimensions.
limits: Held-out task improvement unverified
Training runtime is not human working time
Not foundation-model creation or frontier-model superiority

role_gaps_to_state_honestly: No verified company-wide AI rollout or managed production portfolio scale
No verified low-value automation retirement with savings
No all-time spend/token count or human-hour ledger
